exposure: in vitro fertilization (IVF) and fresh embryo transfer
cohort: 88 singleton pregnancies conceived through IVF-FET and 176 spontaneously conceived pregnancies, matched for age, gravidity, parity, and gestational week at delivery
finding: The study found that IVF-FET is an independent risk factor for third stage of labor complications, including PPH, need for manual lysis, and revision of the uterine cavity.
mod_finding: Singleton pregnancies conceived through frozen-thawed embryo transfer (FET) are associated with an increased risk of postpartum hemorrhage, manual lysis, and revision of the uterine cavity during vaginal delivery.
